note: Routing-gate decisions. Both languages must reproduce every decision exactly: matched constants are what keeps the choice of route from being measure-visible. Driven from one fixture so a shared error cannot pass twice. Positions pin both endpoints so the span is fixed across K within a shape, making the K-sweep vary only K. K is the first density's value count and Ky the second's; cases with K == Ky sweep one count, cases with K != Ky pin the unequal-count case, where the second density's self matrix dominates the centres route.
